checks: Verified e25e172f74df55a2 §§1–2, (1)–(5) and the explicit Q_* formula. Its group index only labels fixed cap traces, so no group concurrency is needed.

For W near I exactly one vertex is captured. The intercept fraction on edge i to j is (W_ii-a)/(W_ii-W_ij); preserving the barycentric sum makes det W the physical Jacobian. Thus the formula is for actual cap volume.
Differentiating along I+tB gives the two displayed log derivatives. After eliminating b_j through the zero column sums, the A_ij coefficient in D(L/V) is -1+sum_l e_l-e_i+chi_j.

Given two rows, d>=2 gives a third common column, so equality of the coefficients forces all e_i equal. If e=0 nonnegative weights force every chi_i=0, violating stationarity. Since X>1, e>0 then yields chi_i>0 and e<1/d. This gives the stated effective threshold in (0,1).

With common mean, the squared first log derivative contributes +d^2 sigma_i^2 b_i^2 and the second log derivative contributes -d sigma_i^2 b_i^2 inside the cap Hessian. Subtracting e times their sum gives the stated negative correction and exact vanishing condition.
